_comment: Copy to config.json and pass with --config. Everything is optional; omitted keys keep the defaults in lib/match.py.

_thresholds_help.auto_merge: Pairs at or above this, with no blocker, are merged without anyone looking. Raise to 0.95 for a first cautious pass; lower to 0.88 once you trust the review queue.
_thresholds_help.review_low: Pairs between review_low and auto_merge land in review-queue.csv. Lower it to catch more possible duplicates at the cost of a longer queue.
_thresholds_help.year_slack: Years this far apart still count as the same year (catalogues disagree about copyright vs printing dates).
_thresholds_help.max_block: Blocking buckets larger than this are skipped as junk (e.g. 5000 records with no title). Skipped buckets are listed in cluster-report.json.

_weights_help: Weights are renormalised over whichever components have evidence on both sides, so a book is never penalised for having no volume or issue.
